text: Japan tech group will expand Philippine plant, raise per-unit storage capacity The Philippine plant expansion will be Toshiba's first major investment in its hard disk drive business in about five years. (Source photos by Toshiba and Nikkei) MANILA -- Japanese technology group Toshiba plans to double production capacity for hard-disk drives used in artificial intelligence data centers within fiscal 2027 from its 2025 level as the AI boom propels data storage demand.
